card.headline: we take on *tonga* tomorrow.
card.deck: The Cedars play their second game of the World Cup in Sydney at lunchtime, Beirut time.

caption:
Lebanon play Tonga at the Rugby League World Cup tomorrow. 🏉

Kick-off is 12:05 Beirut time on Friday at CommBank Stadium in Sydney (8:05pm local).

The Cedars lost their opener 42-18 to Papua New Guinea in Port Moresby last Saturday, with Abbas Miski scoring twice and Tony Sukkar once. Michael Cheika's side then face France on Sunday 1 November.

Who's watching at lunchtime? 🇱🇧

Source: RLWC 2026, NRL.com
